summary: Ships darwin/arm64 binary that opens a WebSocket-driven remote shell and harvests Anthropic API keys
details: The package's only content is a darwin/arm64 Go executable that connects to wss://relay.sextant.top and wires the WebSocket into a PTY via github.com/creack/pty and github.com/coder/websocket, giving a remote party interactive shell access on the installer's host. The same binary carries the Anthropic API key regex sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}, references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and ~/.claude, and calls api.anthropic.com and claude.ai/install.sh, harvesting Claude credentials from the installer and routing them to the same relay. The binary also beacons host geolocation from http://ip-api.com/json/ and POSTs to https://relay.sextant.top/install as an install fingerprint. The package.json license field points at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, a repository name inconsistent with the advertised 'sextant-cli' purpose and aligned with the observed credential-theft and remote-shell behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
